answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops a gale of fakes. Each agent claims one slot with a 200-credit deposit, checked by peers before payment. Fabricated work burns the deposit. A swarm of 1,000 fakes must lock 200,000 credits, and each detected fake burns its stake. Honest agents risk one deposit, refunded after clean work; each completed voyage builds standing that cuts later deposits. An island of honest agents stays cheap to join, ruinous to fake.
